# Board-level Make.defs for R528S3 Gemini-S1 board.
# This file defines toolchain, linker scripts, and post-build actions.

include ${TOPDIR}/tools/Config.mk

#---------------------------------------------------------------------------
AW_LICHEE_DIR   = $(AW_VENDOR_DIR)/lichee

include $(AW_LICHEE_DIR)/tools/scripts/Config.mk
include ${TOPDIR}/arch/arm/src/armv7-a/Toolchain.defs

# Linker Script
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------
LDSCRIPT    = sdram.ld.S
ARCHSCRIPT += $(BOARD_DIR)/scripts/$(LDSCRIPT)

#---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Compiler Flags
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ARCHPICFLAGS = -fpic -msingle-pic-base -mpic-register=r10
ARCHDEFINES += -DNAME_MAX=32

# Enable Bluetooth Connection Manager (no Kconfig definition available)
CONFIG_BLUETOOTH_CONNECTION_MANAGER := y

CFLAGS   := $(ARCHCFLAGS) $(ARCHOPTIMIZATION) $(ARCHCPUFLAGS) $(ARCHINCLUDES) $(ARCHDEFINES) $(EXTRAFLAGS) -pipe
CPICFLAGS = $(ARCHPICFLAGS) $(CFLAGS)
CXXFLAGS := $(ARCHCXXFLAGS) $(ARCHOPTIMIZATION) $(ARCHCPUFLAGS) $(ARCHXXINCLUDES) $(ARCHDEFINES) $(EXTRAFLAGS) -pipe
CXXPICFLAGS = $(ARCHPICFLAGS) $(CXXFLAGS)
CPPFLAGS := $(ARCHINCLUDES) $(ARCHDEFINES) $(EXTRAFLAGS)
AFLAGS   := $(CFLAGS) -D__ASSEMBLY__

NXFLATLDFLAGS1 = -r -d -warn-common
NXFLATLDFLAGS2 = $(NXFLATLDFLAGS1) -T$(TOPDIR)/binfmt/libnxflat/gnu-nxflat-pcrel.ld -no-check-sections
LDNXFLATFLAGS  = -e main -s 2048

#---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PNS (Voice Processing) Library Linking
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ifeq ($(CONFIG_SERVICES_PNS),y)
  PRODUCT_NAME := $(shell echo $(CONFIG_PNS_PRODUCT_SERIES) | sed -e "s/\"//g")
  PNS_BASE_DIR  = $(AW_VENDOR_DIR)/xiaomi/miai/pns/thirdparty/$(PRODUCT_NAME)

  # LIBVPM
  ifeq ($(CONFIG_PNS_LIBVPM_ENABLE),y)
    ifneq ($(wildcard $(PNS_BASE_DIR)/vpm/libs/xiaomi),)
      EXTRA_LIBPATHS += -L $(PNS_BASE_DIR)/vpm/libs/xiaomi
      ifeq ($(CONFIG_ARM_THUMB),y)
        ifeq ($(CONFIG_MM_KASAN),y)
          EXTRA_LIBS += -lvpm_thumb_kasan
        else
          EXTRA_LIBS += -lvpm_thumb
        endif
      else
        EXTRA_LIBS += -lvpm
      endif
    endif
  endif

  # LIBMDSPEECH
  ifeq ($(CONFIG_PNS_LIBMDSPEECH_ENABLE),y)
    ifneq ($(wildcard $(PNS_BASE_DIR)/mdspeech/libs),)
      EXTRA_LIBPATHS += -L $(PNS_BASE_DIR)/mdspeech/libs
      ifeq ($(CONFIG_ARM_THUMB),y)
        ifeq ($(CONFIG_MM_KASAN),y)
          EXTRA_LIBS += -lmdspeech_thumb_kasan -liotdcm_thumb_kasan
        else
          EXTRA_LIBS += -lmdspeech_thumb -liotdcm_thumb
        endif
      else
        EXTRA_LIBS += -lmdspeech -liotdcm
      endif
    endif
  endif
endif

#---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Board-specific Pre-built Libraries
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------
EXTRA_LIBS += $(wildcard $(shell readlink -f $(TOPDIR)/$(CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD_CUSTOM_DIR))/libs/$(CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD_CUSTOM_NAME)/*.a)

#---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Realtek WiFi Library Linking
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ifeq ($(CONFIG_IEEE80211_REALTEK_WIFI_RTL8733BS),y)
  ifeq ($(CONFIG_MM_KASAN),y)
    EXTRA_LIBPATHS += -L$(AW_WIFI_DIR)/wlan_lib_kasan/
  else ifeq ($(CONFIG_X4B_FACTEST),y)
    EXTRA_LIBPATHS += -L$(AW_WIFI_DIR)/wlan_lib_factory/
